facts.business: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of fertilizers, primarily urea, and related petrochemical products.

capacity_or_capex.item: Urea plant capacity expansion project at Tuticorin

key_risks: Subsidy income recognition and recoverability subject to significant judgement and interpretation of government notifications
Delay in urea revamp project completion from original target of March 2026 to September 2026
Dependence on government subsidy policies for urea under New Pricing Scheme
Related party transactions and borrowings from related parties
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include Greenstar Fertilizers Limited, Tuticorin Alkali Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited, Sicagen India Limited, AM International Holdings Pte Ltd, and others. Key transactions: sale/purchase of goods, reimbursement of expenses, services rendered, storage charges, rent, interest on borrowings (Rs 8.99 cr in FY26), borrowings repaid (Rs 80 cr in FY26), and managerial remuneration (Rs 3.46 cr in FY26).
